title: Inspect European dynamic selector witnesses
changes: Document the bounded direct-call and task-byte producer evidence for dynamic fragment selectors.
validation: Rechecked all 24 known direct setter callsites and authenticated seven original Windows disassembly windows under Wine; inspected producers yield only 3, 7 or 8.
limitations: The local inspection does not exclude alias, indexed or external writers and does not establish a global selector bound or positive ordinary use; Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
